model._about: Every model parameter, with its status. REAL = published or observed data; DERIVED = computed in this repository from REAL data; ASSUMPTION = chosen by the author, not sourced; ILLUSTRATIVE = used only in a worked example. results/inputs_used.json echoes this file.

background_factor.label: ASSUMPTION
background_factor.note: AM peak-hour car traffic / modelled resident commuter car traffic. The model has no goods vehicles, buses, taxis between jobs, non-work trips, non-resident workers or workers without a fixed workplace; this single factor stands in for all of them and is not calibrated to anything

bpr_alpha.label: REAL
bpr_alpha.note: Bureau of Public Roads (1964), Traffic Assignment Manual, U.S. Department of Commerce

capacity_per_lane.label: ASSUMPTION
capacity_per_lane.note: pcu/h/lane, hourly link capacity used in the BPR function (signal losses included for at-grade roads)

car_occupancy.label: ASSUMPTION
car_occupancy.note: persons per car or taxi on the commute; not verified

connectors_per_zone.label: ASSUMPTION
connectors_per_zone.note: nearest road nodes on non-motorway links, preferring nodes inside the zone

free_flow_speed_factor.label: ASSUMPTION
free_flow_speed_factor.note: free-flow speed = factor x speed limit (at-grade roads lose time at signals even when empty)

lanes_default.label: ASSUMPTION
lanes_default.note: lanes per direction where OpenStreetMap has no lanes tag

speed_default_kmh.label: ASSUMPTION
speed_default_kmh.note: where OpenStreetMap has no maxspeed tag

cost.label: ASSUMPTION
cost.value: road network distance (km) along the free-flow shortest-time path between zone centroids

deterrence.label: ASSUMPTION
deterrence.note: functional form; a and b are calibrated

intrazonal_factor.label: ASSUMPTION
intrazonal_factor.note: intrazonal distance = factor x distance to the nearest other zone centroid

tld_bin_km.label: ASSUMPTION
tld_bin_km.note: bin width for trip-length distributions and the coincidence ratio

attendance_factor.label: ASSUMPTION
attendance_factor.note: share of employed residents with a fixed workplace who travel to it on an average weekday (leave, sickness, shifts, hybrid work)

job_weight_per_m2_gfa.label: ASSUMPTION
job_weight_per_m2_gfa.note: relative jobs per m2 of estimated floor area by MP2019 land-use class; they only share the Census workplace total of a planning area among its subzones, so only ratios within a planning area matter

plot_ratio_defaults.label: ASSUMPTION
plot_ratio_defaults.note: MP2019 parcels whose GPR is a code (LND landed housing; EVA, SDP, NA) get these plot ratios when floor area is estimated

production_weight.label: ASSUMPTION
production_weight.note: employed residents of a planning area are spread over its subzones in proportion to Census 2020 residents aged 20-64

min_approach_flow.label: ASSUMPTION
min_approach_flow.note: pcu/h; approaches below this are left out of the phase plan

practical_x.label: ASSUMPTION
practical_x.note: degree of saturation treated as the practical limit

saturation_flow_pcu_per_lane.label: ASSUMPTION
saturation_flow_pcu_per_lane.note: base saturation flow per approach lane; HCM 2000 uses 1,900 pc/h/ln as the base value

car_speed_factor.label: ASSUMPTION
car_speed_factor.note: car times in mode choice are free-flow network times (no supply-demand feedback)

car_terminal_min.label: ASSUMPTION
car_terminal_min.note: parking and walking at both ends of a car trip

central_area.label: REAL
central_area.note: URA Central Area flag in the Master Plan 2019 subzone boundary data
central_area.value: CA_IND = Y in the MP2019 subzone layer

modes.label: ASSUMPTION
modes.note: car = car only + taxi/private-hire car only; pt = any combination of MRT/LRT and public bus (including with other modes); other = private chartered bus/van, lorry/pickup, motorcycle/scooter, others. 'No transport required' is left out of the trip matrix.

am_peak_hour.label: DERIVED
am_peak_hour.note: 07:00-07:59, the weekday morning hour with most bus tap-ins in LTA DataMall origin-destination volumes (July and August 2026)

bus_weekdays.label: ASSUMPTION
bus_weekdays.note: Monday-Friday days less public holidays: July 2026 has 23 weekdays and no public holiday; August 2026 has 21 weekdays, less Monday 10 August. The Ministry of Manpower's 2026 list (https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/public-holidays, retrieved 2026-11-15) gives National Day on Sunday 9 August 2026 and says Monday 10 August 2026 is a public holiday if the rest day falls on 9 August. Whether DataMall files 10 August under WEEKDAY or WEEKENDS/HOLIDAY was not verified; 20 is assumed.

morning_window.label: ASSUMPTION
morning_window.note: tap-in hours 05:00-10:59 taken as the outbound morning window when deriving the peak-hour share

bus_speed_kmh.label: ASSUMPTION
bus_speed_kmh.note: bus-only alternative: road distance at this speed, including stops

max_access_km.label: ASSUMPTION
max_access_km.note: stations further than this from a zone centroid are not connected to it

max_walk_km.label: ASSUMPTION
max_walk_km.note: beyond this a station is reached by feeder bus

wait_weight.label: ASSUMPTION
wait_weight.note: weight of waiting time relative to in-vehicle time

walk_detour.label: ASSUMPTION
walk_detour.note: walking or feeder distance / straight-line distance

walk_weight.label: ASSUMPTION
walk_weight.note: weight of walking time relative to in-vehicle time

jrl_stations.label: REAL
jrl_stations.note: LTA Jurong Region Line page; see config/rail.json
jrl_stations.value: 24 stations (all three stages, JS2A left out)

other_growth.label: ASSUMPTION
other_growth.note: outside Tengah, 2030 population and jobs are held at 2020 levels so that the scenarios isolate Tengah and the JRL

persons_per_home.label: ASSUMPTION
persons_per_home.note: close to the Census 2020 average resident household size; not taken from a specific table

tengah_buildout_by_2030.label: ASSUMPTION
tengah_buildout_by_2030.note: the whole town is taken as completed and occupied by 2030. This is an upper bound: HDB's completion schedule was not checked, and the split of the 42,000 homes between public and private housing was not verified (all are treated as public housing, the zones' 2020 private-housing share being 0)

tengah_homes.label: REAL
tengah_homes.note: HDB: Tengah 'is estimated to provide about 42,000 new homes when fully developed' (Annex B to HDB's 2024 news release on four Tengah BTO projects and ABC Waters certification, https://www.hdb.gov.sg/-/media/hdb-pulse/news/2024/four-tengah-bto-projects-awarded-top-tier-active-beautiful-clean-waters-certification/Annex-B.pdf, retrieved 2026-11-15); the same figure appears in HDB's Tengah Town Design Guide

tengah_jobs.label: ASSUMPTION
tengah_jobs.value: Tengah's MP2019 non-residential parcels x job weights x (jobs per weight unit in the West Region)

seed.label: ASSUMPTION
seed.note: fixed seed; the pipeline is deterministic, the seed is used only for jitter in figures

rail_base_year_rule.label: ASSUMPTION
rail_base_year_rule.note: Left out of base2020 because they opened after 2020: Thomson-East Coast Line stages 2-4 (TE4 onwards), Hume (DT4), Punggol Coast (NE18), Teck Lee (PW2); never-opened or future stations (CC18, CC30-CC32, NS3A, DT36-DT37, TE30 onwards, Cross Island Line) are also left out. The opening dates of these stations were not individually verified in this study; the line list itself follows the LTA codes.
rail_base_year_rule.value: stations in operation at the Census of Population 2020 reference period

lrt.label: ASSUMPTION
lrt.note: as above, for the light rail loops

mrt.label: ASSUMPTION
mrt.note: average speed between stations including dwell; not verified against timetables
